verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וְנֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ יְה֣וֹנָתָ֔ן דָּוִ֑ד נִקְשְׁרָ֖ה בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן וַיֶּאֱהָבוֹ כְּנַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw lə·ḏab·bêr ’el- šā·’ūl wə·ne·p̄eš yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān dā·wiḏ niq·šə·rāh bə·ne·p̄eš yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān way·yɛ·ʾɛ̆·hå̄·ḇō kə·nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: After David had finished speaking with Saul the souls of Jonathan and David were knit together . . . and Jonathan loved him as himself

verses.original: הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם שָׁא֖וּל וַיִּקָּחֵ֥הוּ וְלֹ֣א נְתָנ֔וֹ לָשׁ֖וּב אָבִֽיו׃ בֵּ֥ית
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm šā·’ūl way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū wə·lō nə·ṯā·nōw lā·šūḇ ’ā·ḇîw bêṯ
verses.literal: And from that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return to his father’s house

verses.original: יְהוֹנָתָ֛ן וַיִּכְרֹ֧ת בְּרִ֑ית וְדָוִ֖ד בְּאַהֲבָת֥וֹ אֹת֖וֹ כְּנַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān way·yiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ wə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·’a·hă·ḇā·ṯōw ’ō·ṯōw kə·nap̄·šōw
verses.literal: Then Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself

verses.original: יְהוֹנָתָ֗ן אֶֽת־ וַיִּתְפַּשֵּׁ֣ט הַמְּעִיל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ לְדָוִ֑ד וּמַדָּ֕יו וְעַד־ חַרְבּ֥וֹ וְעַד־ קַשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְעַד־ חֲגֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ’eṯ- way·yiṯ·paš·šêṭ ham·mə·‘îl ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw way·yit·tə·nê·hū lə·ḏā·wiḏ ū·mad·dāw wə·‘aḏ- ḥar·bōw wə·‘aḏ- qaš·tōw wə·‘aḏ- ḥă·ḡō·rōw
verses.literal: And Jonathan - removed the robe - he was wearing and gave it to David along with his tunic . . . his sword . . . his bow . . . and his belt

verses.original: דָוִ֜ד וַיֵּצֵ֨א יַשְׂכִּ֔יל בְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁאוּל֙ יִשְׁלָחֶ֤נּוּ שָׁא֔וּל וַיְשִׂמֵ֣הוּ עַ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיִּיטַב֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י כָל־ הָעָ֔ם שָׁאֽוּל׃פ עַבְדֵ֥י וְגַ֕ם בְּעֵינֵ֖י
verses.transliteration: ḏā·wiḏ way·yê·ṣê yaś·kîl bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer šā·’ūl yiš·lā·ḥen·nū šā·’ūl way·śi·mê·hū ‘al ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yî·ṭaḇ bə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hā·‘ām šā·’ūl ‘aḇ·ḏê wə·ḡam bə·‘ê·nê
verses.literal: So David marched out [and] prospered in everything - Saul sent him to do and Saul set him over the men of war And this was pleasing in the sight of all the people and of Saul’s officers as well . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י בְּבוֹאָ֗ם בְּשׁ֤וּב דָּוִד֙ מֵהַכּ֣וֹת אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֔י הַנָּשִׁ֜ים וַתֵּצֶ֨אנָה מִכָּל־ עָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לִקְרַ֖את הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ שָׁא֣וּל לָשׁוּר וְהַמְּחֹל֔וֹת בְּשִׂמְחָ֖ה בְּתֻפִּ֥ים וּבְשָׁלִשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ḇō·w·’ām bə·šūḇ dā·wiḏ mê·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tî han·nā·šîm wat·tê·ṣe·nāh mik·kāl ‘ā·rê yiś·rā·’êl liq·raṯ ham·me·leḵ šā·’ūl lå̄·šūr wə·ham·mə·ḥō·lō·wṯ bə·śim·ḥāh bə·ṯup·pîm ū·ḇə·šā·li·šîm
verses.literal: As the troops vvv were returning home after David had killed - the Philistine the women came out of all the cities of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing with joyful songs and with tambourines and other instruments

verses.original: הַֽמְשַׂחֲק֖וֹת הַנָּשִׁ֥ים וַתֹּאמַ֑רְןָ וַֽתַּעֲנֶ֛ינָה שָׁאוּל֙ הִכָּ֤ה בְּאַלְפּוֹ וְדָוִ֖ד בְּרִבְבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ham·śa·ḥă·qō·wṯ han·nā·šîm wat·tō·mar·nā wat·ta·‘ă·ne·nāh šā·’ūl hik·kāh bə·ʾal·pō wə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·riḇ·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: And as the women danced . . . vvv they sang out Saul has slain [his] thousands and David his tens of thousands

verses.original: לְשָׁא֜וּל וַיִּ֨חַר מְאֹ֗ד וַיֵּ֤רַע בְּעֵינָיו֙ הַזֶּ֔ה הַדָּבָ֣ר נָתְנ֤וּ רְבָב֔וֹת לְדָוִד֙ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר נָתְנ֖וּ הָאֲלָפִ֑ים וְלִ֥י וְע֥וֹד ל֖וֹ אַ֥ךְ הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·šā·’ūl way·yi·ḥar mə·’ōḏ way·yê·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nāw haz·zeh had·dā·ḇār nā·ṯə·nū rə·ḇā·ḇō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ way·yō·mer nā·ṯə·nū hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·lî wə·‘ō·wḏ lōw ’aḵ ham·mə·lū·ḵāh
verses.literal: And Saul was furious . . . and resented . . . this song They have ascribed tens of thousands to David he said but only thousands to me What more can he have but the kingdom

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י הַה֖וּא מֵהַיּ֥וֹם וָהָֽלְאָה׃ס שָׁא֖וּל עָוֹן אֶת־ דָּוִ֑ד
verses.transliteration: way·hî ha·hū mê·hay·yō·wm wā·hā·lə·’āh šā·’ūl ʿå̄·wōn ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: And from that day forward Saul kept a jealous eye - on David

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת רוּחַ֩ רָעָ֤ה׀ אֱלֹהִ֨ים׀ וַתִּצְלַ֣ח אֶל־ שָׁאוּל֙ וַיִּתְנַבֵּ֣א בְתוֹךְ־ הַבַּ֔יִת וְדָוִ֛ד מְנַגֵּ֥ן כְּי֣וֹם׀ בְּי֑וֹם שָׁאֽוּל׃ בְּיָד֖וֹ וְהַחֲנִ֖ית בְּיַד־
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ rū·aḥ rā·‘āh ’ĕ·lō·hîm wat·tiṣ·laḥ ’el- šā·’ūl way·yiṯ·nab·bê ḇə·ṯō·wḵ- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·ḏā·wiḏ mə·nag·gên kə·yō·wm bə·yō·wm šā·’ūl bə·yā·ḏōw wə·ha·ḥă·nîṯ bə·yaḏ-
verses.literal: - The next day a spirit of distress sent from God came upon Saul and he prophesied inside the house while David played [the harp] vvv as usual Now Saul was holding a spear . . .

verses.original: שָׁאוּל֙ אֶֽת־ וַיָּ֤טֶל הַחֲנִ֔ית וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַכֶּ֥ה בְדָוִ֖ד וּבַקִּ֑יר דָּוִ֛ד וַיִּסֹּ֥ב מִפָּנָ֖יו פַּעֲמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl ’eṯ- way·yā·ṭel ha·ḥă·nîṯ way·yō·mer ’ak·keh ḇə·ḏā·wiḏ ū·ḇaq·qîr dā·wiḏ way·yis·sōḇ mip·pā·nāw pa·‘ă·mā·yim
verses.literal: and he - hurled it . . . thinking I will pin David to the wall But David eluded him twice

verses.original: שָׁא֖וּל וַיִּרָ֥א מִלִּפְנֵ֣י דָוִ֑ד כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֙ הָיָ֤ה עִמּ֔וֹ וּמֵעִ֥ם סָֽר׃ שָׁא֖וּל
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yi·rā mil·lip̄·nê ḏā·wiḏ kî- Yah·weh hā·yāh ‘im·mōw ū·mê·‘im sār šā·’ūl
verses.literal: So Saul was afraid of David because the LORD was with David but had departed from Saul

verses.original: שָׁאוּל֙ מֵֽעִמּ֔וֹ וַיְסִרֵ֤הוּ וַיְשִׂמֵ֥הוּ ל֖וֹ שַׂר־ אָ֑לֶף וַיֵּצֵ֥א הָעָֽם׃פ וַיָּבֹ֖א לִפְנֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl mê·‘im·mōw way·si·rê·hū way·śi·mê·hū lōw śar- ’ā·lep̄ way·yê·ṣê hā·‘ām way·yā·ḇō lip̄·nê
verses.literal: Therefore Saul . . . sent [David] away and gave him command of a thousand men David led the troops {out to battle} and back . . .

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דָוִ֛ד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל לְכָל־ דְּרָכָ֖ו וַֽיהוָ֖ה עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏā·wiḏ maś·kîl lə·ḵāl də·rå̄·ḵå̄w Yah·weh ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: and he continued . . . to prosper in all his ways because the LORD was with him

verses.original: שָׁא֔וּל וַיַּ֣רְא אֲשֶׁר־ ה֖וּא מְאֹ֑ד מַשְׂכִּ֣יל וַיָּ֖גָר מִפָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yar ’ă·šer- hū mə·’ōḏ maś·kîl way·yā·ḡār mip·pā·nāw
verses.literal: When Saul saw that David was very successful he was afraid of him

verses.original: וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִיהוּדָ֔ה אֹהֵ֖ב אֶת־ דָּוִ֑ד כִּֽי־ ה֛וּא יוֹצֵ֥א וָבָ֖א לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh ’ō·hêḇ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ kî- hū yō·w·ṣê wā·ḇā lip̄·nê·hem
verses.literal: But all Israel and Judah loved - David because he was leading them out to battle and back -

verses.original: שָׁא֜וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ דָּוִ֗ד הִנֵּה֩ הַגְּדוֹלָ֤ה בִתִּ֨י מֵרַב֙ אֹתָהּ֙ אֶתֶּן־ לְךָ֣ לְאִשָּׁ֔ה אַ֚ךְ הֱיֵה־ חַ֔יִל לִּ֣י לְבֶן־ וְהִלָּחֵ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה מִלְחֲמ֣וֹת וְשָׁא֣וּל אָמַ֗ר אַל־ תְּהִ֤י יָדִי֙ בּ֔וֹ יַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃ס וּתְהִי־ ב֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ’el- dā·wiḏ hin·nêh hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ḇit·tî mê·raḇ ’ō·ṯāh ’et·ten- lə·ḵā lə·’iš·šāh ’aḵ hĕ·yêh- ḥa·yil lî lə·ḇen- wə·hil·lā·ḥêm Yah·weh mil·ḥă·mō·wṯ wə·šā·’ūl ’ā·mar ’al- tə·hî yā·ḏî bōw yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ū·ṯə·hî- ḇōw
verses.literal: Then Saul said to David Here is my older daughter Merab - I will give her to you in marriage Only be valiant for me and fight the LORD’s battles But Saul was thinking vvv I need not raise my hand against him let the hand of the Philistines be against him

verses.original: דָּוִ֜ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ שָׁא֗וּל מִ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ וּמִ֣י חַיַּ֔י אָבִ֖י מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּֽי־ אֶהְיֶ֥ה חָתָ֖ן לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer ’el- šā·’ūl mî ’ā·nō·ḵî ū·mî ḥay·yay ’ā·ḇî miš·pa·ḥaṯ bə·yiś·rā·’êl kî- ’eh·yeh ḥā·ṯān lam·me·leḵ
verses.literal: And David said to Saul Who am I and what is my family or my father’s clan in Israel that I should become the son-in-law of the king

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּעֵ֥ת תֵּ֛ת אֶת־ שָׁא֖וּל בַּת־ מֵרַ֥ב לְדָוִ֑ד וְהִ֧יא נִתְּנָ֛ה לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ לְעַדְרִיאֵ֥ל הַמְּחֹלָתִ֖י
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·‘êṯ têṯ ’eṯ- šā·’ūl baṯ- mê·raḇ lə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·hî nit·tə·nāh lə·’iš·šāh lə·‘aḏ·rî·’êl ham·mə·ḥō·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: So when it was time to give - Saul’s daughter Merab to David she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah

verses.original: שָׁא֖וּל אֶת־ בַּת־ מִיכַ֥ל וַתֶּאֱהַ֛ב דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּגִּ֣דוּ לְשָׁא֔וּל הַדָּבָ֖ר וַיִּשַׁ֥ר בְּעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl ’eṯ- baṯ- mî·ḵal wat·te·’ĕ·haḇ dā·wiḏ way·yag·gi·ḏū lə·šā·’ūl had·dā·ḇār way·yi·šar bə·‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: Now Saul’s - daughter Michal loved David and when this was reported to Saul it pleased him

verses.original: אֶתְּנֶ֤נָּה לּוֹ֙ שָׁא֜וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר וּתְהִי־ לְמוֹקֵ֔שׁ ל֣וֹ יַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּתְהִי־ ב֖וֹ שָׁאוּל֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ דָּוִ֔ד בִּשְׁתַּ֛יִם הַיּֽוֹם׃ תִּתְחַתֵּ֥ן בִּ֖י
verses.transliteration: ’et·tə·nen·nāh lōw šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ū·ṯə·hî- lə·mō·w·qêš lōw yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm ū·ṯə·hî- ḇōw šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ’el- dā·wiḏ biš·ta·yim hay·yō·wm tiṯ·ḥat·tên bî
verses.literal: I will give her to [David] Saul thought so that she may be a snare to him and the hand of the Philistines may be against him So Saul said to David For a second [time] now you can be my son-in-law

verses.original: שָׁא֜וּל אֶת־ וַיְצַ֨ו עֲבָדָ֗ו דַּבְּר֨וּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֤ד בַּלָּט֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֨ה הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ חָפֵ֤ץ בְּךָ֙ וְכָל־ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֲהֵב֑וּךָ וְעַתָּ֖ה בַּמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ הִתְחַתֵּ֥ן
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl ’eṯ- way·ṣaw ʿă·ḇå̄·ḏå̄w dab·bə·rū ’el- dā·wiḏ bal·lāṭ lê·mōr hin·nêh ham·me·leḵ ḥā·p̄êṣ bə·ḵā wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’ă·hê·ḇū·ḵā wə·‘at·tāh bam·me·leḵ hiṯ·ḥat·tên
verses.literal: Then Saul - ordered his servants Speak to David privately and tell him Behold the king is pleased with you and all his servants love you Now therefore become his son-in-law

verses.original: שָׁאוּל֙ עַבְדֵ֤י וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֖ים דָוִ֔ד אֶת־ דָּוִ֗ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַֽנְקַלָּ֤ה בְעֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הִתְחַתֵּ֣ן בַּמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאָנֹכִ֖י רָ֥שׁ אִֽישׁ־ וְנִקְלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl ‘aḇ·ḏê way·ḏab·bə·rū bə·’ā·zə·nê hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ḏā·wiḏ ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer han·qal·lāh ḇə·‘ê·nê·ḵem hiṯ·ḥat·tên bam·me·leḵ wə·’ā·nō·ḵî rāš ’îš- wə·niq·leh
verses.literal: But when Saul’s servants relayed . . . these words to David - he replied Does it seem trivial in your sight to be the son-in-law of the king I am a poor man and lightly esteemed

verses.original: עַבְדֵ֥י וַיַּגִּ֜דוּ שָׁא֛וּל ל֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאֵ֖לֶּה כַּדְּבָרִ֥ים דָּוִֽד׃פ דִּבֶּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ‘aḇ·ḏê way·yag·gi·ḏū šā·’ūl lōw lê·mōr hā·’êl·leh kad·də·ḇā·rîm dā·wiḏ dib·ber
verses.literal: And the servants told Saul - what . . . David had said

verses.original: שָׁא֜וּל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר תֹאמְר֣וּ כֹּֽה־ לְדָוִ֗ד לַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֵ֤פֶץ אֵֽין־ בְּמֹ֔הַר כִּ֗י בְּמֵאָה֙ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים עָרְל֣וֹת לְהִנָּקֵ֖ם הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ בְּאֹיְבֵ֣י וְשָׁא֣וּל חָשַׁ֔ב דָּוִ֖ד לְהַפִּ֥יל אֶת־ בְּיַד־ פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yō·mer ṯō·mə·rū kōh- lə·ḏā·wiḏ lam·me·leḵ ḥê·p̄eṣ ’ên- bə·mō·har kî bə·mê·’āh pə·liš·tîm ‘ā·rə·lō·wṯ lə·hin·nā·qêm ham·me·leḵ bə·’ō·yə·ḇê wə·šā·’ūl ḥā·šaḇ dā·wiḏ lə·hap·pîl ’eṯ- bə·yaḏ- pə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: Saul replied Say - to David The king desires no other dowry but a hundred Philistine foreskins as revenge on his enemies But Saul intended to cause David’s death - at the hands of the Philistines

verses.original: עֲבָדָ֤יו וַיַּגִּ֨דוּ הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֣ים לְדָוִד֙ אֶת־ דָוִ֔ד וַיִּשַׁ֤ר הַדָּבָר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י בַּמֶּ֑לֶךְ לְהִתְחַתֵּ֖ן וְלֹ֥א מָלְא֖וּ הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yag·gi·ḏū hā·’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’eṯ- ḏā·wiḏ way·yi·šar had·dā·ḇār bə·‘ê·nê bam·me·leḵ lə·hiṯ·ḥat·tên wə·lō mā·lə·’ū hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: When the servants reported these terms to David - [he] was pleased . . . . . . to become the king’s son-in-law - vvv Before the wedding day arrived

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד וַאֲנָשָׁ֗יו וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ׀ ה֣וּא וַיַּ֣ךְ מָאתַ֣יִם אִישׁ֒ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים֮ דָוִד֙ אֶת־ וַיָּבֵ֤א עָרְלֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וַיְמַלְא֣וּם בַּמֶּ֑לֶךְ לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְהִתְחַתֵּ֖ן שָׁא֛וּל אֶת־ וַיִּתֶּן־ בִּתּ֖וֹ מִיכַ֥ל ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām dā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šāw way·yê·leḵ hū way·yaḵ mā·ṯa·yim ’îš bap·pə·liš·tîm ḏā·wiḏ ’eṯ- way·yā·ḇê ‘ā·rə·lō·ṯê·hem way·mal·’ūm bam·me·leḵ lam·me·leḵ lə·hiṯ·ḥat·tên šā·’ūl ’eṯ- way·yit·ten- bit·tōw mî·ḵal lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: - David and his men went out . . . and killed two hundred . . . Philistines He - brought their foreskins and presented them as payment in full to become the king’s son-in-law Then Saul - gave his daughter Michal to [David] {in marriage}

verses.original: שָׁאוּל֙ וַיֵּ֔דַע וַיַּ֤רְא כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־ דָּוִ֑ד שָׁא֖וּל בַּת־ וּמִיכַ֥ל אֲהֵבַֽתְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yê·ḏa‘ way·yar kî Yah·weh ‘im- dā·wiḏ šā·’ūl baṯ- ū·mî·ḵal ’ă·hê·ḇaṯ·hū
verses.literal: When Saul . . . realized that the LORD was with David and that his daughter Michal loved [David]

verses.original: שָׁא֗וּל וַיֹּ֣אסֶף ע֑וֹד לֵרֹ֛א מִפְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס שָׁא֛וּל וַיְהִ֥י דָּוִ֖ד אֹיֵ֥ב אֶת־
verses.transliteration: šā·’ūl way·yō·sep̄ ‘ō·wḏ lê·rō mip·pə·nê ḏā·wiḏ kāl- hay·yā·mîm šā·’ūl way·hî dā·wiḏ ’ō·yêḇ ’eṯ-
verses.literal: he grew even more . . . afraid of David So from then on . . . Saul was David’s enemy -

verses.original: מִדֵּ֣י צֵאתָ֗ם פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֣י׀ שָׂרֵ֣י וַיֵּצְא֖וּ דָּוִד֙ שָׂכַ֤ל מִכֹּל֙ שָׁא֔וּל עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁמ֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃ס וַיִּיקַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: mid·dê ṣê·ṯām p̄ə·liš·tîm way·hî śā·rê way·yê·ṣə·’ū dā·wiḏ śā·ḵal mik·kōl šā·’ūl ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·mōw mə·’ōḏ way·yî·qar
verses.literal: Every time . . . the Philistine . . . commanders came out [for battle] David was more successful than all of Saul’s officers so that his name was highly esteemed
